content:
Do not add, edit or "correct" project knowledge in CLAUDE.md - decisions, architecture notes, contracts, rules, workflow guidance. All of it belongs in the memory MCP (memory_store / memory_add_rule), which loads into every session, is searchable, and is what this project exists to provide. Stated by the user on 2026-09-05 after a session edited three paragraphs of CLAUDE.md: "we never use it; all the memory must be inside memory mcp, not the claude md file."

The file still exists in the repo with older text about the bridge and the agent team; that text is the user's to trim or delete, not something to keep in step by hand. If it contradicts a memory, the memory wins - say so rather than editing the file.
summary: Do not add, edit or "correct" project knowledge in CLAUDE
title: Never write project knowledge into CLAUDE.md; memory lives in the memory MCP
